lesson: The whole Lean migration runs under the existing cross-platform exclusion, emits every discovered candidate exactly once as eligible, excluded, or invalid with identities and reason, refuses any invalid row, and revalidates complete coverage plus eligible inventory under that same lock immediately before each per-task pointer commit. A valid exact-task selected generation is the byte-stable completion sentinel rather than mixed-proof failure; fixed triples must bind product_delta_digest(marker base_main_sha, marker commit), completed-manifest early returns must first reject linked ancestors, and zero-byte or family-malformed exact artifacts are invalid.
